cohort: Singleton pregnancies with marginal cord insertion (MCI) compared to pregnancies without MCI.
finding: Marginal cord insertion (MCI) was significantly associated with increased maternal (pre-eclampsia, placenta abruption), fetal (nuchal cord entanglement, low birth weight), and neonatal (NICU admission) adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Marginal cord insertion was associated with an increased rate of cesarean delivery.
